```
import os
import pytest
from langfuse._client.span_processor import LangfuseSpanProcessor
from langfuse._client.environment_variables import LANGFUSE_OTEL_MAX_BATCH_SIZE_BYTES

class NoOpSpanExporter:
    def export(self, spans):
        from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SpanExportResult
        return SpanExportResult.SUCCESS
    def shutdown(self):
        pass

def test_span_processor_max_batch_size_bytes_argument_overrides_env(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv(LANGFUSE_OTEL_MAX_BATCH_SIZE_BYTES, "9999")
    processor = LangfuseSpanProcessor(
        public_key="pk-test",
        secret_key="sk-test",
        base_url="http://example.com",
        max_batch_size_bytes=12345,
        span_exporter=None,
    )
    try:
        exporter = processor._span_exporter
        # OTLPSpanExporter exposes max_request_size attribute
        assert getattr(exporter, "max_request_size", None) == 12345
    finally:
        processor.shutdown()
```

Note: we passed span_exporter=None, so default exporter will be created.
